runtime_policy: Never treat membership in this corpus as an error or an automatic rewrite. A match is at most a prompt to test semantic function, evidence, register, audience and contrast.

sources.provenance: A reader said in 2014 that he had been collecting Ilyakhov's stop words for a script. Ilyakhov thanked him for the list. This does not establish that the file is an official, complete or current Glavred database export.
Glavred describes its database as a maintained collection of rules, stop words, examples and links, but does not expose a complete public word-list export on the About page.
Defines the operational boundary: delete only stop words that add no information; a Glavred score is not a text-quality score.

important_counterexamples: A technical term or fixed name can contain a candidate adjective and remain the most precise wording.
A personal or possessive pronoun may be required for natural Russian, responsibility or contrast.
A time expression is meaningful when it contrasts periods or anchors an event.
An intensifier may carry genuine emotion or author voice.
An introductory expression may mark uncertainty, attribution, example status or discourse structure.
Official/legal wording may require a nominalization or institutional formula.
